strings.errorblankchoice: Please check the choices: Choice {$a} is empty.
strings.errormissingchoice: Please check the question text: {$a} was not found in the choices! Only numbers with choice answers specified are allowed to be used as placeholders.
strings.errornoslots: The question text must contain placeholders like [[1]] to show where the missing words go.
strings.errorquestiontextblank: You must enter some question text.
strings.pleaseputananswerineachbox: Please put an answer in each box.
strings.pluginname_help: Select missing words questions require the respondent to select correct answers from drop-down menus. [[1]], [[2]], [[3]], ... are used as placeholders in the question text, with the correct answers specified as choice answers 1, 2, 3, ... respectively. Extra choice answers may be added to make the question harder. Choice answers may be grouped to restrict answers available in each drop-down menu.
strings.pluginnameadding: Adding a select missing words question
strings.pluginnameediting: Editing a select missing words question
strings.pluginnamesummary: Missing words in the question text are filled in using drop-down menus.
strings.privacy:metadata: Select missing words question type plugin allows question authors to set default options as user preferences.
strings.privacy:preference:defaultmark: The default mark set for a given question.
strings.privacy:preference:penalty: The penalty for each incorrect try when questions are run using the 'Interactive with multiple tries' or 'Adaptive mode' behaviour.
strings.privacy:preference:shuffleanswers: Whether the answers should be automatically shuffled.
strings.regradeissuenumchoiceschanged: The number of choices in group {$a} changed.
strings.regradeissuenumgroupsschanged: The number of groups of choices has changed.
strings.tagsnotallowedatall: {$a->tag} is not allowed. (No HTML is allowed here.)
